text: Failed to build iOS app on Xcode 16 is rarely your Dart code. Upgrade Flutter, raise Podfile to iOS 13, wipe Pods and ~/Library DerivedData, then pod install.
.NET 10 SDK now prunes runtime-shipped NuGet packages out of the restore graph by default. 70% fewer ghost CVEs, restore up to 50% faster.
Azure Functions on .NET 11: pick isolated worker. In-process retires Nov 10, 2026 with .NET 8 LTS. Native AOT now beats it on cold start.
Migrating Blazor Server to Blazor Web App on .NET 11: keep every page on InteractiveServer and behaviour stays identical.
Microsoft's new Binlog MCP server gives an AI 15 tools to read your MSBuild .binlog: find failures, slow targets, diff two builds.
ValueTask<T> removes a Task allocation on synchronous completion. The price: await once, never block, never store it.
Two gcdumps five minutes apart show which type is leaking. Then dumpheap -live and gcroot in dotnet-dump show what holds it.
